subject: Pilot terms and one-time onboarding discount for HIPAA + HSM residency trial
messages:
From: Emma Collins <emma.collins@wellera.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Cc: legal@wellera.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Quick question on pilot pricing for HIPAA + HSM residency

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — team was impressed with the latency and KV cache behavior. We want to run a short pilot (3 months) to validate performance in our VPC with HIPAA scope and the HSM-backed keying. Procurement asked me to clarify a few items before we proceed: 

- Can Redwood offer a one-time onboarding discount/credit that offsets the initial HSM provisioning and evidence work?
- For the pilot, how do you price audit-log retention vs. full production (we only need 90 days for pilot)?
- Any minimum committed spend for a pilot that needs to be on the PO?

If possible, can you outline a simple pricing path (pilot pricing, conversion to production, and one-time credits)? We have a proposed SOW draft ready to attach.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Emma

Emma Collins
Senior Procurement Manager | Wellera Health
emma.collins@wellera.com
+1 415-555-0198

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Collins <emma.collins@wellera.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Quick question on pilot pricing for HIPAA + HSM residency

Hi Emma — great to hear the demo landed well. Below is a concise pilot path and the options we typically use. I copied Ben (sales lead) and Dev (solutions) for technical/econ notes.

Pilot proposal (3 months):
- One-time onboarding credit: we can offer a $15k onboarding credit applied to the first invoice to cover HSM provisioning and evidence packaging. Credit is separate from the SOW and amortizes against onboarding fees.
- Pilot runtime: Hosted Private VPC with HSM; pilot price = standard Redwood Dedicated pilot rate (listed on the SOW) minus a 20% pilot discount on recurring per-token charges.
- Audit log retention: pilot retention tier = 90 days; rate set at the 90-day pilot tier (typically 40% below our 365-day tier). If the customer converts to production and upgrades retention, we invoice the delta pro-rated.
- Commit: no long-term commit required for the pilot. If you opt for a production conversion within 120 days, we can move the onboarding credit toward production implementation costs instead.

Next steps:
1) Attach your SOW draft (I see you mentioned it) — Dev will confirm HSM evidence scope.
2) Ben to confirm final commercial concession and any small PO minimums for accounting.
3) I will provision a draft DocuSign with the onboarding credit as an exhibit for legal review.

I attached a short matrix below for clarity. Happy to hop on a 20-min sync if helpful.

— Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0123

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, Emma Collins <emma.collins@wellera.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:07:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot pricing summary and credit mechanics

Emma — quick commercial note to confirm the economics Jasmine proposed.

- One-time onboarding credit: $15,000 (applied to first invoice). This is a non-recurring credit and can be re-applied to production implementation if conversion happens within 120 days.
- Pilot recurring concession: 20% off recurring per-token and HSM seat charge for the 3-month window.
- PO minimum: Accounting prefers a $10k PO for pilots to trigger internal processing; we can accept the first invoice as a $10k stub and apply the onboarding credit to reduce net-outflow if needed.

If Wellera is comfortable, I can draft a short Commercial Exhibit that lists the credit, pilot discount, and PO language. Laura can advise on contract/redline flow.

Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Hi Emma — attaching a quick scope note for HSM and evidence packaging.

Key technical items for SOW and evidence delivery:
- HSM provisioning: hardware-backed key wrap; Redwood will provide HSM-generated attestation and key lifecycle documentation within 7 business days of provisioning.
- Audit logs: for the 90-day pilot we will enable compressed audit export with daily snapshots to your S3 bucket; full ingestion for production is a separate line item.
- Testing window: we recommend a 2-week performance validation window inside the pilot prior to go/no-go.

Attachments: Wellera_SOW_draft.pdf (your draft), HSM_Evidence_Specs.xlsx (we filled the evidence checklist).

If anything in the checklist needs to be stricter for your auditors, flag it and we will adjust.

— Dev

Jasmine/Laura — we reviewed the commercial exhibit Ben mentioned. A couple of redlines from our side: 

1) Clarify that the onboarding credit is a credit against fees only and does not change Redwood's obligations for evidence delivery.
2) Request a 30-day post-pilot access window to retrieve logs and evidence; please confirm retention/pricing for that export window.

If you can provide a one-page exhibit addressing the two points, we can sign the pilot SOW and issue the PO.

Thanks,

Maria/Emma — thanks for the quick review. We can accept both requests: 

- Onboarding credit: will remain credit-only and explicitly excluded from warranty/obligation language in the exhibit.
- Post-pilot access window: we will provide a 30-day export window at no charge for the first export (one-time), subsequent production exports will follow standard export pricing.

Ben will circulate the one-page Commercial Exhibit today and I will prepare the DocuSign wrapper so legal can sign the SOW and we can receive the PO.

Action items:
- Ben: draft exhibit and attach to DocuSign.
- Dev: confirm the evidence checklist timeseries format for the export (CSV vs. NDJSON) and sign off.
- Emma: confirm PO amount (we recommended $10k to start).

If everyone is aligned we can get signatures by early next week and provision the pilot the following business day.

— Jasmine
